qualification.details: Ph.D. in Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or related discipline. Minimum 60% or equivalent grade from Graduation onward. Minimum 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th. Prior experience in two or more of the following areas: Density Functional Theory, Ab initio Molecular Dynamics, Classical Molecular Dynamics, and Kinetic Monte Carlo. Excellent programming abilities (preferably in Python, Fortran, or C++), analytical skills, and knowledge of high-performance computing are also required. Expertise in high-throughput computing, machine-learning methods, and optimization methods will be an added advantage.

To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.

Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar is 20th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,00,000/- per month for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline, along with specific minimum grades from Graduation, 10th, and 12th standard.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIT Gandhinagar recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Post-Doctoral Fellow at IIT Gandhinagar is a temporary role.

faq.question: Q8. What specific experience is required for this role?
faq.answer: Prior experience in areas like Density Functional Theory, Ab initio Molecular Dynamics, Classical Molecular Dynamics, and Kinetic Monte Carlo is required.

faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
